programme.how_found: study.um.edu.my home -> Programmes -> Undergraduate Faculties -> Faculty of Computer Science -> list of six Bachelor of Computer Science specialisations; UM offers no plain/generic 'Bachelor of Computer Science', so the Software Engineering track (broadest general-CS curriculum) was chosen. All six tracks share the same entry requirements, English minimums and international fee (RM 89,200).
programme.notes: Faculty of Computer Science and Information Technology (FSKTM). Duration 3.5 years (7 semesters + 1 special semester), coursework, Semester 1 (October) intake. The programme page does not name a campus; the FAQ lists the Main Campus in Kuala Lumpur, and the other campuses (Bachok; UMCCed) do not host FSKTM bachelor programmes per the booklet, but the programme-campus link is not stated verbatim. Teaching language is the university-wide default (English unless otherwise specified); the programme page specifies nothing else.

english.quote: Obtained a minimum English language Competency in any ONE (1) of the following requirements: MUET 4.0 IELTS (Academic) 5.5 TOEFL iBT (Centre-based) 46 TOEFL Essentials (Online) 8.0 Pearson Test of English (PTE Academic) 51
english.how_found: Programme page, 'English Language Requirements' -> International column.
english.notes: IELTS Academic 5.5 overall (no band minimums stated). TOEFL iBT must be centre-based; FAQ says TOEFL Home Edition, TOEFL ITP, IELTS Indicator and IELTS UKVI are not accepted; tests valid 2 years. Cambridge English Qualifications score 160 (B1 Preliminary to C2 Proficiency). A conditional offer may be issued pending English results.

value.description: Senior High School Certificate (SHSC), international column: pass with minimum average of 65%; at least 60% / B- in Mathematics and at least 60% / B- in one of Physics, Computing, Chemistry, Biology. Other routes: Matriculation/Foundation CGPA 3.00, A-Level B in Maths + one science, IB 30 points, AUSMAT ATAR 80.

gpa.quote: Senior High School Certificate (SHSC) Pass with a minimum average of 65% Obtain a minimum of 60% / grade B- in Mathematics subjects. Obtain a minimum of 60%/ grade B- in any ONE (1) subject: Physics, Computing, Chemistry, Biology
gpa.notes: UM does not name Kazakhstan's NIS grade 12 certificate; the 'Senior High School Certificate (SHSC)' row is the generic route for national high-school diplomas and is the closest match, but recognition/equivalence of the NIS certificate is not confirmed on the site. No admission test is required for this programme. FAQ: selection is based on academic merit, competition for places and fulfilment of entry requirements. Predicted/provisional/expected results are not accepted.

deadline.quote: UNDERGRADUATE - FOR INTERNATIONAL 09 Feb 2026 30 Aug 2026 except for below programmes: - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (9 June 2026)
deadline.how_found: study.um.edu.my -> How to Apply -> 'Application period for Undergraduate Programmes', row 'UNDERGRADUATE - FOR INTERNATIONAL' under Semester I (October) intake, Academic Session 2026/2027.
deadline.notes: Only the 2026/2027 cycle is published (Semester I, October 2026 intake: applications 09 Feb 2026 to 30 Aug 2026; page last updated Oct 14, 2026). The 2027/28 deadline (October 2027 intake) is NOT yet published; by analogy it would fall around late August 2027, but that is unconfirmed. A Semester II (March 2027) international window 07 Sept 2026 to 30 Jan 2027 also exists, but the programme page lists only the Semester 1 (October) intake for this programme. International application fee MYR 500.

value.academic_year: latest published (programme page updated 2026-10-16; International Booklet updated 15 Dec 2025); 2027/28 not separately published

tuition.quote: International RM 89,200 ( Note: Not inclusive of 6% Sales and Service Tax (SST))
tuition.how_found: Programme page 'Tuition Fee' section; cross-checked against the International Booklet PDF fee table (p.12: 'Bachelor of Computer Science (Software Engineering) 89,200.00 ... 3.5 years').
tuition.notes: Excludes 6% SST. The page does not literally say 'per programme', but the booklet lists each fee next to the programme duration (e.g. 1-year foundation 35,000; 5-year MBBS 673,200) and states: 'The Admission Fee is included in the total tuition fee.' — so RM 89,200 is the total for the full 3.5-year programme (~RM 25,500/yr), not per year. Interpretation of period is inference from layout; confirm with bursar_student@um.edu.my. Booklet URL: https://study.um.edu.my/doc/booklets/International%20Booklet%20-%20Updated%2015%20Dec%202025.pdf

scholarship_exists.quote: Do you have scholarship for Undergraduate International Students? We do not offer scholarship to the Undergraduate International Students.
scholarship_exists.how_found: Search -> aasd.um.edu.my 'FAQ Undergraduate International Admission' and 'Financial Aid For Undergraduate' pages.
scholarship_exists.notes: UM's own FAQ says it offers no scholarship to undergraduate international students (this FAQ page may be older: it quotes an RM300 application fee whereas study.um.edu.my now lists MYR 500). Externally sponsored option: the AASD financial aid page (updated 14/10/2026) lists the 'PTE x Universiti Malaya Scholarship 2026' (Pearson PTE partnership, GBP 3,000 toward tuition, deadline 31 Dec 2026) — quote: 'We’re excited to announce the PTE x Universiti Malaya Scholarship 2026 – a unique opportunity for international students to receive £3,000 towards their tuition fees at Universiti Malaya.' (https://aasd.um.edu.my/financial-aid-for-undergraduate). It is a partner/sponsor award detailed on pearsonpte.com (not read, non-official domain), not a UM-run scholarship, and undergraduate eligibility and 2027/28 continuation are not confirmed on um.edu.my. Other listed awards (MMC, EcoWorld, AIA) are external and/or for Malaysians.

scholarship_international.quote: Do you have scholarship for Undergraduate International Students? We do not offer scholarship to the Undergraduate International Students.
scholarship_international.notes: False for university-run scholarships. Caveat: the externally sponsored PTE x Universiti Malaya Scholarship 2026 is explicitly for international students (see scholarship_exists notes).
